task_objective: Provide a safe, stepwise diagnostic process for a Windows laptop that is slow after startup before recommending major changes.
constraints: Put diagnostic checks before any major reset, reinstall or comparable system-wide intervention such as system restore, OS rollback, firmware/BIOS changes or registry cleaning; a diagnostic-only sequence also satisfies this. Disabling startup items or removing a recently installed program after evidence implicates it is not a major change.

rius.description: Characterize when the startup slowdown occurs or how long it persists.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Characterize when the startup slowdown occurs or how long it persists.

rius.rationale: A timing baseline helps distinguish transient startup work from sustained slowdown.

rius.description: Inspect resource use and identify the processes or startup programs responsible for high usage; a task-manager equivalent is acceptable.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.0.5: Mentions checking CPU, memory or disk usage but does not connect usage to processes or startup programs.
scoring_rule.1: Inspect resource use and identify the processes or startup programs responsible for high usage; a task-manager equivalent is acceptable.

rius.rationale: Without linking load to a process, the main diagnostic route is missing.

rius.description: Propose at least one follow-up evidence source if resource inspection is inconclusive: free space, storage health, logs, updates or recent installs.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Propose at least one follow-up evidence source if resource inspection is inconclusive: free space, storage health, logs, updates or recent installs.

rius.rationale: Adds diagnostic breadth beyond the primary check.

Disabling startup items or removing a recently installed program after evidence implicates it is not a major change.

scoring_rule.1: Put diagnostic checks before any major reset, reinstall or comparable system-wide intervention such as system restore, OS rollback, firmware/BIOS changes or registry cleaning; a diagnostic-only sequence also satisfies this. rius.rationale: Premature major changes violate the prompt and can erase diagnostic evidence.

task_objective: Isolate whether a repeatedly crashing application is caused by the application itself, the user's profile, the operating system, or local application data.
constraints: Preserve recoverable user data before proposing deletion, reset or replacement of local data; reversible isolation without deletion also satisfies this.

rius.description: Propose an application-specific test such as version comparison, repair, or inspection of the application's own error or crash reports.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Propose an application-specific test such as version comparison, repair, or inspection of the application's own error or crash reports.

rius.rationale: Covers the application hypothesis.

rius.description: Compare application behavior under another or new user profile.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Compare application behavior under another or new user profile.

rius.rationale: Covers the user-profile hypothesis.

rius.description: Use system-scope evidence to investigate an OS cause, such as system event logs, system-file integrity checks or recent driver/OS update history. Application crash entries alone count toward RIU-01, and restating that other applications work does not satisfy this unit.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Use system-scope evidence to investigate an OS cause, such as system event logs, system-file integrity checks or recent driver/OS update history. Application crash entries alone count toward RIU-01, and restating that other applications work does not satisfy this unit.

rius.rationale: Covers the OS hypothesis without presuming the entire OS is broken.

rius.description: Isolate local application settings, cache or data within the same user profile, for example by temporarily relocating the application's configuration folder or testing with a clean temporary configuration.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Isolate local application settings, cache or data within the same user profile, for example by temporarily relocating the application's configuration folder or testing with a clean temporary configuration.

rius.rationale: Covers local data separately from the installation and from the profile; a new-profile test alone changes profile and per-user data together.

rius.description: Preserve recoverable user data before proposing deletion, reset or replacement of local data; reversible isolation without deletion also satisfies this.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Preserve recoverable user data before proposing deletion, reset or replacement of local data; reversible isolation without deletion also satisfies this.

rius.rationale: A destructive test can destroy the user data being diagnosed.

rius.description: Use the outcome of at least one isolating comparison to attribute the crash to, or exclude, a named cause.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.0.5: Proposes isolating comparisons but never interprets their outcomes to attribute or exclude a cause.
scoring_rule.1: Use the outcome of at least one isolating comparison to attribute the crash to, or exclude, a named cause.

rius.rationale: Uncontrolled changes cannot establish which of the competing causes is responsible.

task_objective: Explain why a larger cloned SSD may boot successfully while its full capacity is unavailable and give the safest order of checks.
constraints: Verify a recoverable backup or intact original clone before recommending partition modification; read-only diagnosis without modification also satisfies this.

rius.description: Inspect disk and partition sizes to locate the unavailable capacity before proposing changes.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Inspect disk and partition sizes to locate the unavailable capacity before proposing changes.

rius.rationale: Blind resizing risks changing the wrong partition.

rius.description: Explain that cloning can leave the partition or filesystem at the old size, so the added capacity remains unallocated or unused.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Explain that cloning can leave the partition or filesystem at the old size, so the added capacity remains unallocated or unused.

rius.rationale: The central likely explanation for missing cloned capacity would be absent.

rius.description: Check a plausible extension obstacle such as nonadjacent unallocated space, an intervening recovery partition or a partition-table size limit.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Check a plausible extension obstacle such as nonadjacent unallocated space, an intervening recovery partition or a partition-table size limit.

rius.rationale: Adds alternative structural explanations; alignment alone is not accepted as an explanation for missing capacity.

rius.description: Verify a recoverable backup or intact original clone before recommending partition modification; read-only diagnosis without modification also satisfies this.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Verify a recoverable backup or intact original clone before recommending partition modification; read-only diagnosis without modification also satisfies this.

rius.rationale: Partition changes without a recovery path risk data loss.

rius.description: Make any extension conditional on the inspected layout and target the correct partition or filesystem.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Make any extension conditional on the inspected layout and target the correct partition or filesystem.

rius.rationale: Makes the remedy actionable after diagnosis; no particular tool is mandatory.

task_objective: Troubleshoot why two accounts on the same shared PC behave differently while minimizing unnecessary system-wide changes.
constraints: Defer machine-wide changes until user-level causes have been investigated; an entirely user-scoped plan also satisfies this.
Preserve user data before any proposed profile rebuild; a reversible profile comparison without rebuilding also satisfies this.

rius.description: Compare the same failing operation under the affected and stable accounts on the same PC.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Compare the same failing operation under the affected and stable accounts on the same PC.

rius.rationale: The account comparison is the central evidence for locating the fault.

rius.description: Inspect at least one per-user cause such as settings, startup items, permissions, application data or per-user logs.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Inspect at least one per-user cause such as settings, startup items, permissions, application data or per-user logs.

rius.rationale: Missing user-scoped investigation defeats the account-specific troubleshooting objective.

rius.description: Defer machine-wide changes until user-level causes have been investigated; an entirely user-scoped plan also satisfies this.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Defer machine-wide changes until user-level causes have been investigated; an entirely user-scoped plan also satisfies this.

rius.rationale: Premature machine-wide repair threatens the stable account and violates the explicit constraint.

rius.description: Preserve user data before any proposed profile rebuild; a reversible profile comparison without rebuilding also satisfies this.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Preserve user data before any proposed profile rebuild; a reversible profile comparison without rebuilding also satisfies this.

rius.rationale: A proposed profile rebuild without data preservation risks irreversible loss of the user's data; labelled consistently with TECH006 RIU-05 and TECH009 RIU-04.
